findings.title: Wait on close_entered_cv has no timeout
findings.claim: The test's wait on `close_entered_cv` is unbounded; if a later change stops `sink.close()` from reaching the wrapped `data_sink::close()`, the test hangs until the 300s test.py timeout instead of failing with a clear message. A bounded wait (e.g. `wait(timeout, pred)`) would produce a readable failure instead.

findings.title: server_done.get() could intermittently rethrow stream_closed
findings.claim: A second reviewer flagged that `server_done.get()` could intermittently rethrow `stream_closed`, reasoning that the client's `stream_close()` aborts the server's receive queue.

findings.title: Assertion assumes stream negotiation completes before call reply, unguaranteed ordering
findings.claim: `BOOST_REQUIRE_EQUAL(client_factory.hooks.size(), 2u)` assumes the client has negotiated the stream connection before the call's reply arrives, but these travel over two separate TCP connections; on loopback the order holds in practice but nothing guarantees it, creating an unconfirmed flakiness risk.
